name: 搜狗 SERP
body: (function () { var out = []; var nodes = document.querySelectorAll('div.vrwrap, div.rb'); for (var i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) { var n = nodes[i]; var a = n.querySelector('h3 a'); if (!a || !a.href) continue; var s = n.querySelector('.str-text-info') || n.querySelector('.text-layout'); out.push({ title: (a.innerText || a.textContent || '').trim(), url: a.href, snippet: ((s && (s.innerText || s.textContent)) || '').trim() }); } return JSON.stringify(out); })()
